fields.name: mode
fields.title: Mode
fields.description: Generation mode. 'preview' returns untextured geometry only, 'full' returns textured model (preview + refine).

fields.name: seed
fields.title: Seed
fields.description: Seed for reproducible results. Same prompt and seed usually generate the same result.

fields.name: model_type
fields.title: Model Type
fields.description: Type of 3D mesh generation. 'standard' produces a regular high-detail mesh; 'lowpoly' produces a low-poly mesh optimized for cleaner polygons; 'smart-topology' (Smart Topology T2.5) and 'smart-topology-t2' (Smart Topology T2) produce clean, triangle-only meshes with natively separated parts on the g

fields.name: topology
fields.title: Topology
fields.description: Specify the topology of the generated model. Quad for smooth surfaces, Triangle for detailed geometry.

fields.name: target_polycount
fields.title: Target Polycount
fields.description: Target number of polygons in the generated model. When model_type is a smart topology option and this is left unset, that model's default is used instead (15,000 for T2.5, 4,000 for T2); the maximum is 30,000 for T2.5 and 15,000 for T2.

fields.name: should_remesh
fields.title: Should Remesh
fields.description: Whether to enable the remesh phase. When false, returns unprocessed triangular mesh.

fields.name: symmetry_mode
fields.title: Symmetry Mode
fields.description: Controls symmetry behavior during model generation.

fields.name: enable_pbr
fields.title: Enable Pbr
fields.description: Generate PBR Maps (metallic, roughness, normal) in addition to base color.

fields.name: is_a_t_pose
fields.title: Is A T Pose
fields.description: Deprecated: use pose_mode instead. When true, generates a T-pose model.

fields.name: pose_mode
fields.title: Pose Mode
fields.description: Pose mode for the generated model. 'a-pose' generates an A-pose, 't-pose' generates a T-pose, empty string for no specific pose.

fields.name: enable_prompt_expansion
fields.title: Enable Prompt Expansion
fields.description: Whether to enable prompt expansion. This will use a large language model to expand the prompt with additional details while maintaining the original meaning.

fields.name: texture_prompt
fields.title: Texture Prompt
fields.description: Additional text prompt to guide the texturing process (only used in 'full' mode)

fields.name: enable_rigging
fields.title: Enable Rigging
fields.description: Automatically rig the generated model as a humanoid character. Includes basic walking and running animations. Best results with humanoid characters that have clearly defined limbs.

fields.name: rigging_height_meters
fields.title: Rigging Height Meters
fields.description: Approximate height of the character in meters. Only used when enable_rigging is true.

fields.name: enable_animation
fields.title: Enable Animation
fields.description: Apply an animation preset to the rigged model. Requires enable_rigging to be true.

fields.name: animation_action_id
fields.title: Animation Action Id
fields.description: Animation preset ID from Meshy's library. Only used when enable_animation is true; in that case it must be in [0, 696] (``0`` is the "Idle" preset) and is otherwise rejected with a 422. See https://docs.meshy.ai/en/api/animation-library for available action IDs.

fields.name: geometry_resolution
fields.title: Geometry Resolution
fields.description: Geometry resolution. Meshy-7 supports standard and 2k.

fields.name: ultra_mode
fields.title: Ultra Mode
fields.description: Deprecated: use geometry_resolution='2k'. If both fields are provided, geometry_resolution takes precedence.
